candidate_propositions.text: Architected and deployed high-throughput backend services handling 50k requests per second in Go and Node.js.
Expert in Oracle SQL, PostgreSQL B-tree indexing, query tuning, and distributed transaction semantics.
Implemented Apache Kafka event streaming pipeline reducing message delivery latency by 45%.
Trained large-scale vision and language transformer models with PyTorch on multi-GPU clusters.
Built dense semantic retrieval system using vector embeddings with ChromaDB and HNSW similarity search.
Converted transformer checkpoints to ONNX runtime for low-latency sub-5ms inference in production.
Developed scalable React single-page applications with Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and responsive layout patterns.
Created RESTful APIs in Express with JWT authentication, rate limiting, and automated unit testing.
Spearheaded cloud migration to AWS utilizing Terraform IaC, multi-region Kubernetes, and Docker containers.
Automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, reducing release cycle time from days to minutes.
Led development of distributed enterprise backend services using Java Spring Boot and Kafka.
Managed relational schemas with complex foreign keys, ACID compliance, and Oracle PL/SQL stored procedures.
Designed neural embedding pipelines using sentence-transformers for resume-to-job matching.
Integrated Qdrant and Milvus vector stores for fast k-nearest-neighbors candidate retrieval.
Crafted accessible WCAG 2.1 AA compliant UI components using React, Redux Toolkit, and Tailwind.
Built Node.js microservices with PostgreSQL connection pooling and JSON schema validation.
20 years of experience managing enterprise data centers, Linux clusters, and Kubernetes infrastructure.
Enforced zero-downtime rolling deployments and disaster recovery with Terraform automation.
Published papers on dense passage retrieval and reciprocal rank fusion for hybrid search engines.
Fine-tuned Hugging Face transformer models for domain-specific NLP classification tasks.
Wrote low-level network server in C++ and Go with asynchronous epoll I/O handling high concurrency.
Engineered database sharding and replica read distribution for large MySQL and Oracle databases.
Built full-stack dashboards using React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js with Oracle backend.
Maintained 95% test coverage using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress end-to-end suites.
Managed cloud platform engineering division supervising 40 engineers and multimillion cloud budget.
Architected hybrid cloud migration connecting on-premise Oracle ERP to AWS cloud native microservices.
Researched cross-encoder reranking algorithms and approximate nearest neighbor search indexes.
Deployed ML models with Triton inference server and ONNX quantization for 4x speedup.
Developed reactive event-driven backend services with Kafka, Redis Pub/Sub, and Go microservices.
Authored complex PL/SQL packages, analytical window functions, and autonomous audit triggers.
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA); built multi-tenant clusters with Calico networking.
Engineered interactive dashboards with React 18, WebSocket feeds, and responsive Tailwind layouts.
Built a real-time ChromaDB inspector that exposes vector inserts, updates, deletes and similarity queries.

job_criteria.text: 5+ years experience building highly concurrent distributed backend architectures and microservices
Expertise in relational database design, indexing, transaction isolation, and SQL optimization
Hands-on experience with event streams, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and cache layers (Redis)
Strong foundational background in deep learning, transformer architectures, and dense vector embeddings
Practical experience implementing vector databases (ChromaDB, Qdrant, Milvus) for semantic retrieval
Proficiency with PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, and deploying Hugging Face models into production
Proficiency in modern React, component lifecycle, hooks, and responsive Tailwind UI design
Demonstrated experience authoring RESTful and GraphQL endpoints in Node.js/Express
Extensive hands-on experience orchestrating Kubernetes clusters and managing cloud networking
Strong proficiency with Terraform and automated CI/CD pipeline infrastructure

transcripts.text: Q: How do you handle high concurrency and race conditions in distributed systems? | A: We utilize distributed locks with Redis Redlock algorithm or database optimistic concurrency control using version timestamps.

metadata.question_text: How do you handle high concurrency and race conditions in distributed systems?
metadata.answer_text: We utilize distributed locks with Redis Redlock algorithm or database optimistic concurrency control using version timestamps.

transcripts.text: Q: Can you explain the trade-offs between B-tree indexes and HNSW vector indexes? | A: B-trees provide O(log N) exact scalar searches along a single dimension. HNSW constructs a multi-layer graph for Approximate Nearest Neighbors across 384+ dimensions with sub-linear latency.

metadata.question_text: Can you explain the trade-offs between B-tree indexes and HNSW vector indexes?
metadata.answer_text: B-trees provide O(log N) exact scalar searches along a single dimension. HNSW constructs a multi-layer graph for Approximate Nearest Neighbors across 384+ dimensions with sub-linear latency.
